svg.title: L1 signal bus classifies signals into three urgency classes before interpretation
svg.desc: Mixed signals from sensors enter the bus and are sorted into threat, status, and background lanes by simple type and severity rules. Each lane has a different downstream path.

g.text: key principle: classification happens BEFORE interpretation.
interpretation is expensive — it takes deliberation cycles. by the time you fully understand
a threat signal, the window for fast response has often closed. classification only looks at
type and severity, takes microseconds, and decides which downstream path the signal takes.
